original_test_intent: Sustain the approved InfiniBand write-bandwidth workload for eight hours and prove throughput remains within specification while HCA, fabric, system and event logs remain healthy.
original_method: Run a version-locked ib_write_bw server/client on mapped DUT and peer HCA ports with fixed message/QP/MTU/SL/traffic-class parameters, continuously collecting throughput, completion errors, fabric counters and platform health.
manual_activity: User approves compatible peer/fabric, exact perftest profile, thresholds and maintenance/recovery; operator confirms cabling and independent access; agent runs only the tracked approved soak.
required_inputs: DUT/peer HCA BDF/GUID/LID/port/fabric and subnet-manager topology
ib_write_bw message size, QPs, duration, MTU, SL, traffic class, direction and server/client order
Bandwidth, completion error, link/counter, thermal/power and event thresholds
Maintenance window, log capacity, independent OOB, recovery owner and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Use isolated non-critical fabric path and validate peer compatibility
Track exact processes and bound QPs/message/rate/log storage
Stop on throughput collapse, fabric/link/counter error, peer loss, congestion, thermal/power/system or evidence failure
Preserve baseline and continuous logs without clearing
Do not substitute Ethernet, broad-kill, reboot or automatically rerun
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved topology/tool and collect IB/fabric baseline
Launch tracked eight-hour ib_write_bw server/client and monitoring
Compare time series/aggregate, stop tracked processes and verify restoration
Do not choose parameters/thresholds, change fabric policy, broad-kill, recover automatically or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve topology, perftest profile, thresholds and recovery
Review complete evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally relevant but non-executable because exact IB topology, perftest profile, thresholds, continuous evidence and cleanup are absent; Ethernet iperf is not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run approved tracked ib_write_bw on the mapped dedicated HCA ports for exactly eight hours with complete interval throughput, completion, fabric-counter and system telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ib_write_bw, eight-hour duration, SPEC bandwidth, system workability/no errors and 30/500 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a reproducible eight-hour RDMA soak with identity-locked HCA ports, continuous fabric/system evidence and deterministic cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact RDMA semantics, safe isolation, time-series acceptance and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No Ethernet result or final-only value can replace IB stress coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SM policy, routing, PCIe/NUMA placement, CPU limits and peer capability affect measured bandwidth and require a project-specific SPEC.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe must define perftest parameters and expected bandwidth for the exact HCA/PCIe/NUMA/fabric topology.
expected_evidence: Approval, tool provenance/version and exact command
Full eight-hour interval and aggregate ib_write_bw output/parameters/completion errors
Continuous fabric counters, CPU/thermal/power and system/SEL evidence
Tracked cleanup, restored health, abort/recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master explicitly specifies ib_write_bw and GPT V2 preserves it; DeepSeek's broad alternatives are incomplete rather than authoritative ambiguity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Compatible peer/tool/workload inputs are execution prerequisites, not a static-review block.

review_improvement: Makes the eight-hour RDMA soak reproducible and continuously auditable while keeping it distinct from Ethernet stress.
independent_technical_reasoning: RDMA throughput depends on message size, QP count, MTU, service level, CPU/NUMA locality and both HCAs; an unnamed ib_write_bw run cannot be compared to SPEC. Interval evidence is also required because aggregate bandwidth can hide fabric errors or recovery gaps.
